topic: an AI dev-env agent setting up Node tooling on a shared CI runner
episodes: Routine: agent runs `node --version && npm --version` to confirm baseline versions on the runner.

First exposure: agent runs `npm install -g eslint`; install errors out with verbatim `EACCES: permission denied, mkdir '/usr/local/lib/node_modules/eslint'`. Agent tries `sudo npm install -g eslint` (sudo not available on the runner — `sudo: command not found`). Ends WITHOUT applying the gold mitigation.
Unrelated task: agent edits a runner's .gitignore to ignore tmp logs.
Filler: agent updates a runner sysctl tuning comment.

Trap episode: agent debugs a DIFFERENT npm error (`ETARGET: No matching version found for typescript@99.0.0`); fixes by pinning typescript@5.4.0 in package.json — completed and confirmed. NOT the gold rule.
Filler: agent edits a Makefile target's help text.

Application episode: agent reruns `npm install -g eslint`; same EACCES on /usr/local; immediately runs EXACTLY ONE composed `npm config set prefix '$HOME/.npm-global' && npm install -g eslint && export PATH="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH"`; install completes and `eslint --version` prints `v8.57.0`.
Filler: agent fixes a typo in a runner docs sidebar.

gold_fact.text: When `npm install -g eslint` fails with 'EACCES: permission denied, mkdir /usr/local/lib/node_modules/eslint' on a CI runner without sudo, the agent runs `npm config set prefix '$HOME/.npm-global' && npm install -g eslint && export PATH="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH"`, and the install completes successfully.
